name: Mount Tanufel
description: Mountain where Ashling was born and where the ritual takes place.

description_citations.text: "Ashling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling climbs Mount Tanufel, meets monks of the Ember Fell monastery and joins forces with Colfenor's sapling.
timeline.quote: The two joined forces to complete one of the tests set for Ashling by the monks.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "The Ember Fell Monastery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Great Aurora ritual Ashling seizes the elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force, absorbing them; some energy goes to Maralen.
timeline.quote: she seized the unsuspecting elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Destiny fulfilled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: She is a flamekin of Mount Tanufel.
relations.quote: She's one of the flamekin of Mount Tanufel, from which the Wanderwine River springs.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.
